targets.title: Check runner median wall time on main
targets.subject: check runner
targets.statement: The median wall time of the sampled successful check-runner workflow runs on main is at most 900000 ms.

targets.title: Check runner p95 wall time on main
targets.subject: check runner
targets.statement: The 95th percentile wall time of the sampled successful check-runner workflow runs on main is at most 1800000 ms.

targets.title: Sweep type-check member wall time
targets.subject: sweep
targets.statement: The type_check reading produced by a sweep run carries a duration_ms of at most 300000 ms.

targets.title: Sweep lint member wall time
targets.subject: sweep
targets.statement: The lint reading produced by a sweep run carries a duration_ms of at most 180000 ms.

targets.title: Release candidate performance suite wall time
targets.subject: release candidate
targets.statement: The declared performance script the perf_test sensor runs for the release candidate completes within 900000 ms.

targets.title: Release candidate performance suite exit status
targets.subject: release candidate
targets.statement: The declared performance script the perf_test sensor runs for the release candidate exits with status 0.
